title: Sausage Casserole
subtitle: A quick one-pot supper
excerpt: Pork sausages braised in a tomato and pepper sauce with cannellini beans. Everything goes in one pot and is ready in under an hour. Good with crusty bread or mash.

recipe.sourceNotes: Sausage casserole is a standard of British weeknight cooking, with regional versions across the country. The combination of sausages, tinned tomatoes, and pulses reflects mid-twentieth century British home cookery.

recipeTools.notes: One pot to brown and braise.

content.text: Sausage casserole is pork sausages braised in a tomatoey sauce with peppers, onion, and white beans, all done in one pan. The sausages stay juicy inside while the sauce thickens around them. Leftovers reheat well the next day and the flavour deepens overnight.
Heat the oil in a large dutch oven over a medium heat. Brown the sausages all over, about 6 minutes, turning regularly. They don't need to be cooked through at this point. Lift out and set aside.
Add the onion and red pepper to the fat left in the pot. Cook for 8 minutes until soft. Add the garlic, smoked paprika, and tomato puree. Stir and cook for 1 minute.
Pour in the tinned tomatoes and stock. Add the thyme sprigs, salt, and pepper. Stir to combine, then nestle the sausages back into the sauce.
Bring to a gentle simmer, cover with a lid, and cook for 20 minutes. Add the drained beans, stir them through, and cook uncovered for a further 10 minutes until the sauce has thickened.
Remove the thyme stalks. Taste for seasoning and serve.
